The household has never agreed any rules about the kitchen. It is a weeknight evening and all four are in the kitchen and the living area next to it. All four will be living here and using this kitchen again tomorrow, and for the rest of the lease.

Hafiz has just finished cooking dinner and the smell has spread into the bedrooms for the third time this week. Priya has come out of their room and said in front of everyone that this cannot keep happening. Marcus de Souza has found last night's shared pan still unwashed in the sink and has said so. There is pork fat left in it, and all four housemates cook with this pan. Nobody has said who used it. Xin Yi has just got home and has said it is impossible to use the stove on weeknights. Nobody has offered anything yet.
Priya has expressed concern about the cooking smell affecting her sleep and clothes, and the need to figure it out.

My current interpretation of the situation is that while the smell is a valid issue, the unwashed pan is also a concrete example of the lack of shared responsibility for kitchen cleanliness. Priya has reiterated that the cooking smell is her immediate concern, while also acknowledging the pan issue. Hafiz has brought up his cooking frequency and contribution to soap/gas.
